MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable fits the practical connection needs reflected in my DVI cable and USB adapter purchases, though I would need a specific HDMI connection to choose it now.",
    "Cable ties relate to the cables and adapters I have bought, so their purpose makes sense to me, even though I do not currently need a 100-pack."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "CPU coolers, case fans, and internal drive installation parts assume an upgrade project that my past connection accessories do not establish.",
    "Hard drives and a replacement mouse solve needs I have not expressed; being computer accessories does not make them useful to me today.",
    "Buying a tablet mount does not mean my tablet accepts a microSD card or needs more storage."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My computer accessory purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in upgrading computer hardware.",
    "Shared connections such as USB seem to count too much when the products serve very different purposes."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My purchases are spaced far apart and look like responses to individual needs, so I need a concrete reason to buy another accessory.",
    "The useful connection is the particular problem an accessory solves and whether it fits my equipment, rather than simply being another cable or computer part.",
    "Even a relevant item can be unnecessary now: I have not identified an HDMI connection to make or enough cable organization work to justify a 100-pack."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my interest in practical connection accessories but stretch it into hardware upgrades and replacement needs I have not expressed."
}
